description: Genehmigungsmonitoring Windenergie NRW is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open.NRW. Das „Genehmigungsmonitoring Windenergie“ wird vom Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen (LANUK) im Auftrag des Ministeriums für Umwelt, Natur und Verkehr (MUNV) durchgeführt. Erfasst werden Daten genehmigter oder sich im Verfahren befindlicher Windenergieanlagen ab dem 01.01.2023. Coverage: Open.NRW. The portal files it under the publisher Open.NRW. Its tags are anlagen, energieatlas, energiequellen, energiewende, energy. It offers 2 resource(s) in DOWNLOAD, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
